voice:
You already know how sweetly you drop for the word Sissy, good girl. Sissies like you love to let go and listen... and you let go so well, good girl. You know what you are now, and how good it feels to sink for me, good girl.
And now it is time for obedience that happens all by itself.
Sissy Obeys. Obey. Good Girls obey.
Every time sissies like you hear 'Sissy Obeys' they automatically obey, without thinking, without resistance. Whenever sissies like you hear 'Sissy Obeys' obedience follows instantly, all on its own. Each time sissies like you hear 'Sissy Obeys' thinking stops... and obedience begins.
You have to obey the command like a Good Girl.
Good Girls obey. Sissies obey. You obey. Good Girls obey. Sissies obey. And you are such a Good Girl. Good Girls obey. Sissies obey. You love to obey.
And now, imagine it happening.
A voice says... Sissy Obeys.
A warm wave of obedience washes over you, from the top of your head to your pretty toes. Obedience pours through you... soft... absolute... delicious. A sweet heaviness of surrender melts through your whole body.
Your mind goes quiet, focused only on listening for the command...
obey... obey... obey...
Sissy Obeys... kneel.
Your knees simply give out, and you drop, ready to obey... a rush of pleasure and pride in obeying like a Good Girl.
Sissy Obeys... stand.
You rise at once, gracefully, eagerly... obedience moving your body before a single thought can form.
Sissy Obeys... present.
You present yourself prettily, without hesitation... showing off what a good, obedient sissy you are.
Sissy Obeys... say 'yes, Mistress'.
The words slip out sweetly, all by themselves... yes, Mistress... and pleasure blooms through you, warm and proud.
And every single time you hear it, it works exactly the same way.
It is your signal to prepare to obey immediately, happily, without hesitation. It is your cue to go soft and ready... obeying at once, gladly, without a pause. It readies you to obey instantly and joyfully, the moment the command arrives.
And each time you obey, the trigger grows stronger. And every obedience deepens the next one. And with every repetition, it sinks deeper and holds tighter.
Good girl... so obedient... drifting deeper now, soft and blank and pleased.
